name: Image Video Dakara Shinpai Shinakute Ii Yori *chan
original_name: イメージビデオだから心配しなくていいより○ちゃん
source:
I work for a video clip production company on downfall. I was looking for a great model which can work miracles. Then the angel appears. Ri** is a little bit selfish and insolent, but I managed to persuade her into shooting her in swimwear. Then she said that she wanted to go home. Well, in that case...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ044528.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我在一家视频剪辑制作公司工作，但后来公司倒闭了。我一直在寻找一个可以创造奇迹的伟大模型。然后天使出现了。Ri**有点自私和无礼，但我设法说服她穿着泳装拍摄她。然后她说她想回家。嗯，在这种情况下…
